skirmish.module.session_recap.name: Session Recap
skirmish.module.session_recap.descriptio: Totals since you joined the server: kills, deaths, K/D, best fight, totems, time played, experience levels and coins (when the sidebar shows a balance). Opens from its button, /skirmish recap, or by itself after you leave. Can be saved as a picture.
skirmish.module.session_recap.setting.au: Open the recap right after leaving a server (otherwise it is only kept until the next join)
skirmish.module.session_recap.setting.co: Track the balance change from a "Balance"/"Coins" line of the sidebar, when there is one
skirmish.module.session_recap.setting.sh: The current session, or the last finished one when not connected
skirmish.session_recap.title: Session recap
skirmish.session_recap.empty: No data yet: the recap counts from the moment you join a server.
skirmish.session_recap.tile.coins_unknow: coins: no balance in the sidebar
skirmish.session_recap.best.label: Best fight
